t: This is St James's Palace, the most prestigious royal palace in London. It is no longer the monarch's main home, but it gives its name to the Court of St James's. It is the ceremonial meeting place of the Accession Council, and several members of the royal family still have their London homes here. Henry the Eighth commissioned it. Charles the Second and Queen Anne were both born here, and Mary the First died here. The palace takes its name from Saint James the Elder, one of the Twelve Apostles. King Charles the Third has lived here.
